title: Administrative Assistant
description:
ADMINISTRATIVE ASSISTANT (12 MONTH CONTRACT)
MACCLESFIELD, CHESHIRE
UP TO 26,500 + EXCELLENT BENEFITS
POSSIBLE OPPORTUNITY TO GO PERMANENT

THE OPPORTUNITY:

We're partnering with a well-established and growing business in Macclesfield that is looking to recruit an organised and detail-oriented Administrative Assistant to join its Accounts Team on a 12-month fixed term contract.

The successful candidate will provide essential administrative support to the Accounts Team, assisting with data entry, maintaining accurate records, processing documentation and handling customer queries. You'll work closely with colleagues across the business to ensure information is processed accurately and day-to-day administrative tasks are completed efficiently.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong office administration, data entry or customer service experience who is looking to develop their skills within an accounts environment. THE ADMINISTRATIVE ASSISTANT ROLE:
- Providing day-to-day administrative support to the Accounts Team, ensuring tasks are completed accurately and within deadlines

THE PERSON:

- Confident communicating with customers and colleagues via telephone and email

- Available to commit to a 12-month fixed term contract

description:
Accounts Assistant

Middlewich Full Time Permanent
£26,000 - £28,000 per annum

Are you an experienced Accounts Assistant looking for a role where you can make a real impact and build a long-term career? We are recruiting on behalf of a successful and growing business in Middlewich that is seeking a proactive and detail-oriented individual to join its friendly and supportive finance team.

This is a varied, hands-on position offering exposure to all aspects of the finance function. More importantly, it provides genuine opportunities for professional development and career progression, making it an excellent move for someone looking to grow their career within accounts and finance.

The Role

As Accounts Assistant, you'll play a key role in supporting the day-to-day finance operations of the business, ensuring accuracy across financial processes while working closely with colleagues across multiple departments.

Key responsibilities include:
- Daily bank reconciliations
- Preparing and processing sales invoices
- Processing purchase invoices and maintaining accurate Sage records
- Managing cash flow forecasting and bank reconciliations
- Petty cash administration and monthly reconciliations
- Processing employee expenses and mileage claims
- Preparing weekly payment runs
- Assisting with stock counts and maintaining stock records using Excel
- Reconciling supplier statements and resolving discrepancies
- Responding to customer and supplier account enquiries
- Supporting the Sales Administration team with order processing and proforma invoices
- Maintaining accurate finance records and documentation
- Assisting with ad hoc finance and administration duties

About You

We're looking for someone who is organised, accurate, and enjoys working as part of a team.

You'll ideally have:
- Previous experience in an Accounts Assistant, Accounts Clerk, or similar finance role
- Experience using Sage accounting software
- Strong Excel skills
- Knowledge of sales ledger, purchase ledger, and bank reconciliations
- Understanding of VAT coding and accounting procedures
- Excellent attention to detail
- Strong organisational and communication skills
- A positive and flexible attitude

What's on Offer?

Competitive salary of £26,000 - £28,000
Permanent, full-time position
Friendly and supportive working environment
Varied and engaging role with broad finance exposure
Ongoing training and development opportunities
Genuine long-term career progression within a growing business
Opportunity to expand your responsibilities and develop your finance career

If you're looking for more than just another accounts role and want to join a business that will invest in your future, we'd love to hear from you. This is a fantastic opportunity to build a successful long-term career within a company that recognises and rewards commitment, initiative, and ambition.

Apply today for immediate consideration.
